card.line: Tarshish was a far-off place across the sea, known for its ships and rich cargo, and it is where Jonah tried to run when he fled from the LORD.

moments.title: Solomon's Tarshish ships
moments.text: King Solomon's ships of Tarshish came once every three years. They brought gold, silver, ivory, apes, and peacocks.

moments.title: Jehoshaphat's plan fails
moments.text: Jehoshaphat agreed to make ships to go to Tarshish. Because he allied himself with Ahaziah, the LORD destroyed his works, and the ships were unable to sail to Tarshish.

moments.title: Jonah flees toward Tarshish
moments.text: The LORD told Jonah to go to Nineveh. Jonah got up to flee to Tarshish instead, away from the presence of the LORD, and he boarded a ship bound for Tarshish.

moments.title: Daughter of Tarshish
moments.text: Isaiah spoke against Tyre and called to the Daughter of Tarshish. He said there was no longer a harbor.

moments.title: Tarshish leads the way
moments.text: God says the islands will wait for Him, with the ships of Tarshish in the lead. They will bring His people from afar, with silver and gold, to honor the LORD.
